title: RBAC: Service Accounts & Roles
description:
Create a new ServiceAccount named backend-sa in the production namespace.

Create a Role named pod-reader that allows get, watch, and list on pods in the same namespace.

Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount using a RoleBinding named backend-sa-binding.

title: Network Policies
description:
There is an existing deployment named db-app with the label tier=database in the backend namespace.

Create a NetworkPolicy named db-netpol that restricts incoming traffic to db-app. It should ONLY allow ingress traffic from pods with the label tier=frontend in the same namespace.

All other ingress traffic to db-app should be denied.

title: Persistent Storage
description:
Create a PersistentVolume named task-pv-volume with storage capacity of 1Gi, access mode ReadWriteOnce, hostPath /mnt/data, and no storageClassName.

Next, create a PersistentVolumeClaim named task-pv-claim requesting 500Mi of storage that will bind to this PV.

Finally, create a pod named task-pv-pod using the nginx image that mounts this volume at /usr/share/nginx/html.

title: Node Maintenance
description:
You need to perform maintenance on the node k3d-cka-agent-0.

Safely drain the node to ensure no workloads are interrupted. Note that there are pods managed by DaemonSets on this node, which should be ignored during the drain process.

After you have run the command, do not uncordon the node.

title: Sidecar Container Pattern
description:
A pod named legacy-app is running in the default namespace, writing logs to a file at /var/log/app.log.

Modify the pod to add a sidecar container running the busybox image. The sidecar should run the command: tail -f /var/log/app.log so that the logs can be captured via kubectl logs.

You will need to use an emptyDir volume shared between both containers to achieve this.

title: Ingress Routing
description:
Create an Ingress resource named webapp-ingress in the default namespace.

The Ingress should route requests targeting the host ckad.example.com to an existing service named webapp-service on port 80.

Assume the Ingress controller is already installed and listening on the cluster.

title: Taints and Tolerations
description:
Node k3d-cka-agent-1 has been tainted with dedicated=special-team:NoSchedule.

Create a deployment named special-app with 2 replicas using the redis image.

Ensure that the pods in this deployment tolerate the taint and are able to be scheduled on k3d-cka-agent-1.

title: Troubleshooting Services
description:
A service named frontend-svc is not able to route traffic to the pods of the frontend-deploy deployment. The deployment is running fine.

Investigate and fix the issue so that curl frontend-svc from within the cluster successfully returns the application's response.
